issues.detail: The skill does not explicitly handle scenarios where the user provides incomplete or ambiguous business idea details, leaving potential gaps in guidance.
The skill contains extensive explanatory text and examples, which may be more verbose than necessary for quick execution.
The provided TypeScript code example may not run on all AI agents, limiting cross-platform applicability.

scenarios.name: evaluate-single-idea
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies every rubric requirement, while Response B omits key elements such as factor scoring, total score, verdict, strengths/weaknesses, critical risks, assumptions, and a cheapest validation step.

scenarios.name: compare-multiple-ideas
scenarios.rationale: Response A provides a ranking table, verdicts, and detailed analysis for one idea, whereas Response B only gives a recommendation without any scoring or comprehensive comparison.

scenarios.name: identify-red-flags
scenarios.rationale: Response B better covers assumptions and offers a cheap validation step, while Response A lacks a validation recommendation and explicit reference to the 10 evaluation factors.
